violated_contract: Routine cleanup must not destroy staging audio merely because a URL timer elapsed or a processing attempt became terminal. A successful durable projection and surviving byte-bound original archive must authorize source cleanup; malformed receipts and incident preservation windows must retain artifacts without blocking unrelated cleanup. Explicit privacy erasure overrides routine preservation.
canonical_prevention: Store the original-byte/archive binding beside the lease-fenced completed content ledger. Route legacy staging cleanup through one receipt verifier, compare staging checksums and pin deletion generations. Apply one fail-closed capture-window policy before batch cleanup, park and flag malformed or held receipts so later independent artifacts progress, and keep privacy purge outside the hold.
